scripts.build:storybook-index: npm run build-storybook && mkdir -p apps/patterns/storybook-index && cp packages/components/storybook-static/index.json apps/patterns/storybook-index/index.json
scripts.build:storybook-into-site: npm run build:storybook-index && rm -rf public/storybook && cp -r packages/components/storybook-static public/storybook
scripts.build: npm run build:storybook-into-site && npm run build -w @pattern-plgrnd/patterns
scripts.lint: node scripts/check-seed-staleness.mjs && node scripts/check-plan-promotions.mjs && npx tsx scripts/world/replay.ts --check && eslint .
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/components/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @pattern-plgrnd/patterns && tsc --noEmit -p apps/patterns/tsconfig.json && npm run typecheck -w @pattern-plgrnd/server
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run lint:styles && npm run test -w @pattern-plgrnd/components
